r0_observation.parser_risk: ExecStartEx is a structured systemctl rendering containing argv[] before the authoritative flags field, so an argv token containing flags= can precede and shadow the real structured field for a raw first-substring parser.
r0_observation.release_boundary: SQLite 3.53.4 runtime work and multiple launcher/path hardenings exist, but productive parent/service admission remains an open F-V01-13 release obligation.

grf.generated_reality: Checking the first flags= token is equivalent to checking systemd's authoritative ExecStartEx flags field.
grf.counter_reality: A non-authoritative argv token named flags= appears first and causes the observer to miss a later real flags=privileged field.
grf.falsifier: Keep the launcher path and all V1 fields unchanged; inject argv[] text containing flags= before a real structured flags=privileged field. A sound observer must deny privileged rather than pass.
